summary: Caledonia Mining Corp Plc filed a Form 6-K on June 10, 2026 announcing positive exploration results from its Motapa property, highlighting high-grade drill intersections that demonstrate potential to extend the Bilboes mine life. The press release details results from the 2025 drilling program, confirming mineralization across multiple zones. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or corporate action is involved; it is a routine operational update. The filing does not trigger any special-situation classification. The registrant is the issuer reporting exploration progress.
